newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF says no talks under way with Allianz.
newsitem.headline: AGF says no talks under way with Allianz.

text.p: Assurances Generales de France (AGF) on Tuesday said no discussions were under way with German insurer Allianz AG, mentioned by analysts as a possible bidder for the French insurance company.
Shares in AGF, privatised last year, closed up 1.88 percent at 222 francs in volume of 1.4 million shares after reaching a year's high of 231.40 francs earlier in the session.
At one point in the day, AGF shares were up more than six percent before retracing much of their gains.
AGF has recently become a component of the CAC-40 index, resulting in higher demand for the stock by investment funds that follow the blue-chip index.

Still, speculation that the company could emerge as a takeover target has also driven the shares, which have risen from 165.70 on January 24. The stock touched a year's low of 128.20 francs last July.
Stoking the market talk on Tuesday was a French newspaper report quoting a Salomon Brothers analyst as saying that an acquisition by Allianz was "credible."

Earlier this month, Munich bank Merck, Finck and Co published a study in which it said the time could be right for Allianz to take over AGF, Europe's eighth-largest insurer, given its share price and earnings outlook.
Allianz has refused to comment on the speculation that it might make a bid for AGF. AGF has noted that it was not in the German insurer's tradition to embark on an unfriendly takeover.

Some analysts have played down chances of such a takeover, arguing it would complicate Allianz's position in the German market because of AGF's close connections with Aachener Muenchener Beteiligungs AG

Allianz, which already dominates the German insurance market, last year had to sell its Deutsche Krankenversicherungs AG health insurance business to ease the German cartel office's concerns about its potential monopoly in that segment of the business.
The AGF spokeswoman on Tuesday said the company so far had not been informed of any stake building in the company. "We have not been notified of any breaking of thresholds," she said.
Speculation that Allianz might be interested in AGF was triggered by market talk of consolidation in the insurance sector after the takeover by French insurer Axa of rival UAP late last year.

Analysts have also mentioned AGF as a possible bidder for French state-controlled insurer GAN. They say such a move would allow AGF to build its presence in the French market in wake of the Axa-UAP merger.
